notes: Four distinct movable parts are manipulated. The refrigerator remains open while the two upper cabinet doors and the drawer are operated; the upper cabinet doors remain open during the drawer episode. The two cabinet closing midpoints are close together and their exact ordering is less certain because the frames are sampled every eight source frames.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens the refrigerator, separately opens both doors of the upper cabinet above the range hood, opens and later closes a countertop drawer, then closes the two cabinet doors and finally the refrigerator.
